# Compatibility fixtures

`workspace-v1/` contains sanitized, immutable records generated by the actual
`investigation.Store` and `firewall.SampleASA` code exported from release merge
`d7d8299b2b8c7e014309d883c2413aef615332c8` (PR #12), using Go 1.25.14.
They were generated from that source, not by projecting the current evaluator.

One import followed by four TCP investigations, source `192.0.2.42:52000` to
`10.20.4.15`, yields permit on 443, explicit deny on 22, indeterminate on 8443,
and implicit deny on 80. Records use workspace-v1, parser `asa-config-v1`, and
policy-v2. Synthetic credentials are omitted from the sanitized source.

Tests copy the JSON files to a fresh private workspace and verify that current
code reads/replays them without changing their bytes, IDs or checksums. The
fixture directory is never opened directly as a mutable runtime workspace.

`workspace-v2/` was generated by the actual released source at merge
`2855cdae43e2298c12729d5cce1b044e7552ac89` (PR #13), using Go 1.25.14.
It imports `SampleServicesASA` and evaluates TCP source `192.0.2.42:52000`
to `10.20.4.15` on ports 443 (permit), 22 (explicit deny), and 80 (default
deny). Records retain parser-v2 and policy-v3 with their actual saved traces.
They were not reconstructed by removing current path metadata.

`workspace-v3/` was generated using the actual released source at merge
`47b37c265f8a32743f9492c1cc572b563169e8d1` (PR #14), exported with `git archive`,
using Go 1.25.14. It imports `SamplePathASA`, saves outside TCP
`198.51.100.42:52000 -> 198.51.100.15` on ports 443 (modeled forward) and 22
(blocked), and saves the first attached ACL evaluation to real `10.20.4.15:443`
(permit). The parser-v3/path-v1/policy-v3 records were generated by the released
Store APIs, not by modifying a current result or envelope.
